<thought>To determine the number of CH₃ (methyl) groups, the simplest approach is to obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample and count the distinct methyl proton signals (typically around 0.8–1.2 ppm, integrating to 3 H each). One proton NMR measurement should be sufficient.</thought>
